summary: Resolved Sunday 22 November 2026 to identity 68, Dominica XXIV et ultima post Pentecosten, II classis (Missale Romanum 1962, pp. 422-424, nos. 1769-1778, PDF 503-505, read at 200/400 dpi on the registered CMAA facsimile fetched to its registered hash), placed in the last of 26 Sundays after Pentecost by RG 18 ('Ultimo tamen loco semper ponitur ea quae in ordine est XXIV'); St Cecilia (III classis) is impeded and not commemorated (RG 111 b), Trinity Preface, green, Gloria and Credo, no branch. Computation, printed rubrics and calendar, and two dated Ordos (FSSP France, ICRSP France) agree. Not reference-only. research/context.md records the complete ten-element inventory with loci, the oration conclusions (Per Dominum / Per Dominum nostrum / Per Dominum), the chants shared verbatim with the Twenty-third Sunday, wording against the Clementine (including the Epistle's 'voluntatis Dei' and the Gospel's dropped 'ergo'), the Ordinary's appointed parts, lawful Latin and English routes, and the remaining verification plan; main.tex holds only the reserved-owner scaffold comment.
